numerologie_monat.1: Your Personal Month is a One – a month of beginnings. Whatever you set in motion now has a tailwind; hesitating is more likely to cost you strength than to protect you.
numerologie_monat.2: Your Personal Month is a Two – a time for patience and cooperation. Not everything has to be decided right away; sensitivity will take you further than speed.
numerologie_monat.3: Your Personal Month is a Three – expression, exchange, and lightness are emphasized. A good moment to share ideas and tend your connections.
numerologie_monat.4: Your Personal Month is a Four – work on the foundation. Order, routines, and reliability pay off more now than big leaps.
numerologie_monat.5: Your Personal Month is a Five – movement and change are in the air. Stay flexible: the unexpected may turn out to be an opportunity.
numerologie_monat.6: Your Personal Month is a Six – responsibility, family, and care come to the fore. Relationships want tending, including the one with yourself.
numerologie_monat.7: Your Personal Month is a Seven – a reflective time. Retreat, learning, and inner clarity are more fruitful now than outward bustle.
numerologie_monat.8: Your Personal Month is an Eight – achievement, money, and influence are the theme. You can move a lot if you focus your strength.
numerologie_monat.9: Your Personal Month is a Nine – a month of completion. What has run its course may go; that makes room for the next cycle.
numerologie_monat.11: Your Personal Month carries the master number Eleven – intuition and inspiration are heightened, and so is sensitivity. Pay attention to quiet hunches.
numerologie_monat.22: Your Personal Month carries the master number Twenty-Two – big plans can take shape now when vision and practice come together.
numerologie_monat.33: Your Personal Month carries the master number Thirty-Three – devotion and care for others are at the center, though you should not forget yourself.

hellenistisch_haus.1: Your profection year activates the first house – you yourself, the way you come across, and your body are at the center of this year of your life.
hellenistisch_haus.2: Your profection year activates the second house – possessions, income, and whatever gives you security are the themes of this year of your life.
hellenistisch_haus.3: Your profection year activates the third house – communication, short trips, siblings, and neighbors are emphasized.
hellenistisch_haus.4: Your profection year activates the fourth house – home, origins, and family come to the fore in this year of your life.
hellenistisch_haus.5: Your profection year activates the fifth house – joy, creativity, children, and love affairs are among the themes of this year.
hellenistisch_haus.6: Your profection year activates the sixth house – daily work, health, and duties call for attention in this year of your life.
hellenistisch_haus.7: Your profection year activates the seventh house – partnerships, contracts, and the people facing you are at the center.
hellenistisch_haus.8: Your profection year activates the eighth house – shared resources, transformation, and farewells are themes of this year of your life.
hellenistisch_haus.9: Your profection year activates the ninth house – travel, education, worldview, and the search for meaning are emphasized.
hellenistisch_haus.10: Your profection year activates the tenth house – career, reputation, and your public role are in the spotlight in this year of your life.
hellenistisch_haus.11: Your profection year activates the eleventh house – friendships, networks, and hopes for the future are emphasized.
hellenistisch_haus.12: Your profection year activates the twelfth house – a year of stillness and recollection, in which hidden things may come to light.

hellenistisch_herrscher.sonne: The Lord of the Year is the Sun – visibility and self-confidence are called for; today it pays to take a stand.
hellenistisch_herrscher.mond: The Lord of the Year is the Moon – feelings, needs, and moods set the pace; take them seriously today.
hellenistisch_herrscher.merkur: The Lord of the Year is Mercury – conversations, negotiations, and learning carry your year; today the right word counts.
hellenistisch_herrscher.venus: The Lord of the Year is Venus – relationships, beauty, and balance shape your year; today things may also be pleasant.
hellenistisch_herrscher.mars: The Lord of the Year is Mars – drive and assertiveness are called for, but so is friction; today, better determined than heated.
hellenistisch_herrscher.jupiter: The Lord of the Year is Jupiter – growth, trust, and generosity accompany your year; today a wide view pays off.
hellenistisch_herrscher.saturn: The Lord of the Year is Saturn – endurance and responsibility shape your year; today steadiness gets you further than haste.

bazi_beziehung.gleich: The current month carries the same element as your Day Master ({dm}). That strengthens your self-confidence – and brings in people who want similar things to you. Rivalry and camaraderie lie close together.
bazi_beziehung.naehrt: The current month ({monat}) nourishes your Day Master ({dm}). Support, learning, and backing are easier to find – a good moment to accept help.
bazi_beziehung.erschoepft: Your Day Master ({dm}) nourishes the current month ({monat}). Your strength flows into expression, ideas, and projects – creative, but also demanding. Plan for breaks.
bazi_beziehung.kontrolliert: The current month ({monat}) puts pressure on your Day Master ({dm}). Duties and expectations from outside are palpable; discipline and clear priorities help.
bazi_beziehung.beherrscht: Your Day Master ({dm}) dominates the current month ({monat}). You can take hold and shape things – chances for gain and success, as long as you don't overstretch your strength.

arabisch_firdaria.sonne: You are in the Firdaria of the Sun – years in which rank, recognition, and your public role carry weight. Today what counts is what you visibly stand for.
arabisch_firdaria.venus: You are in the Firdaria of Venus – years of relationships, joy, and balance. Today beautiful things may be given room.
arabisch_firdaria.merkur: You are in the Firdaria of Mercury – years of learning, trading, and negotiating. Today a clarifying conversation is worthwhile.
arabisch_firdaria.mond: You are in the Firdaria of the Moon – years of feelings, family, and change. Today your needs deserve attention.
arabisch_firdaria.saturn: You are in the Firdaria of Saturn – years of responsibility, trials, and slow returns. Today patience achieves more than haste.
arabisch_firdaria.jupiter: You are in the Firdaria of Jupiter – years of growth, support, and trust. Today a generous view pays off.
arabisch_firdaria.mars: You are in the Firdaria of Mars – years of drive, competition, and some conflicts. Today determination is called for, not harshness.
arabisch_firdaria.nordknoten: You are in the Firdaria of the North Node – a short phase that favors new things and advancement. Today, stay open to opportunities.
arabisch_firdaria.suedknoten: You are in the Firdaria of the South Node – a short phase of letting go. Today it is easier to leave outdated things behind you.

vedisch_dasha.ketu: Your Mahadasha is the Ketu period – a time of detachment and inner searching. Today withdrawal brings more clarity than busyness.
vedisch_dasha.venus: Your Mahadasha is the Venus period – years of relationships, pleasure, and prosperity. Today harmony may take priority.
vedisch_dasha.sonne: Your Mahadasha is the Sun period – years of self-assertion and authority. Today is a day to take on responsibility visibly.
vedisch_dasha.mond: Your Mahadasha is the Moon period – years of feelings, home, and care. Today the familiar does you good.
vedisch_dasha.mars: Your Mahadasha is the Mars period – years of energy, courage, and asserting yourself. Today vigorous action pays off.
vedisch_dasha.rahu: Your Mahadasha is the Rahu period – years of ambition and unusual paths. Today unconventional ideas can lead you further.
vedisch_dasha.jupiter: Your Mahadasha is the Jupiter period – years of wisdom, growth, and good teachers. Today it is worth seeking or giving advice.
vedisch_dasha.saturn: Your Mahadasha is the Saturn period – years of discipline and hard but lasting work. Today steadiness gets you further.
vedisch_dasha.merkur: Your Mahadasha is the Mercury period – years of learning, communication, and trade. Today is a good day for exchange.

vedisch_gochara.jupiter_unguenstig: Counted from the sign of your natal Moon, Jupiter is in house {haus}, which is considered less helpful – growth now takes more effort of your own.
vedisch_gochara.saturn_guenstig: Counted from the sign of your natal Moon, Saturn is transiting favorably (house {haus}) – perseverance pays off, obstacles can be overcome.
vedisch_gochara.saturn_unguenstig: Counted from the sign of your natal Moon, Saturn is in house {haus} – duties and delays call for patience.
vedisch_gochara.sade_sati: You are in Sade Sati: Saturn is passing over your natal Moon and its neighboring signs. These seven and a half years are considered a time of testing and maturing – don't take on too much at once today.

ausblick_bazi.monat_gleich: These months carry the element {monat}, like your Day Master. Self-confidence will grow; people with similar goals will appear – as companions or as competition.
ausblick_bazi.monat_gleich_2: Again months in {monat}, the element of your Day Master: you stand firmly on your own feet. Partners and rivals are hard to tell apart now – be careful whom you share with.
ausblick_bazi.monat_gleich_3: Once more the time carries your own element ({monat}). Good for plans you carry out alone; with shared money, look closely.
ausblick_bazi.monat_naehrt: {monat} nourishes your Day Master ({dm}). Support, learning, and backing will be easier to find – a time to accept help.
ausblick_bazi.monat_naehrt_2: These months stand in {monat}, which feeds your Day Master ({dm}). Good for learning, further training, and talks with people who have more experience.
ausblick_bazi.monat_naehrt_3: Again {monat} strengthens you from outside: family, teachers, and patrons are more likely to back you. What you apply or ask for has better prospects now.
ausblick_bazi.monat_erschoepft: Your Day Master ({dm}) nourishes {monat}. Your strength will flow into expression, ideas, and projects – creative, but demanding. Plan for breaks.
ausblick_bazi.monat_erschoepft_2: Your Day Master ({dm}) gives strength to {monat}. Ideas flow, speaking and showing come easily – but energy is used up faster than usual.
ausblick_bazi.monat_erschoepft_3: Again your Day Master ({dm}) feeds {monat}: a time for expression, performances, and your own projects. Don't take on more than you can carry.
ausblick_bazi.monat_kontrolliert: {monat} puts pressure on your Day Master ({dm}). Duties and expectations from outside will be palpable; clear priorities help.
ausblick_bazi.monat_kontrolliert_2: {monat} restrains your Day Master ({dm}). Superiors, rules, and deadlines set the pace; keeping your agreements earns respect.
ausblick_bazi.monat_kontrolliert_3: Again {monat} presses on your Day Master ({dm}). No time for going it alone: obligations first, big risks better postponed.
ausblick_bazi.monat_beherrscht: Your Day Master ({dm}) dominates {monat}. You will be able to take hold and shape things – chances for gain, as long as you don't overstretch yourself.
ausblick_bazi.monat_beherrscht_2: {monat} is the element your Day Master ({dm}) overcomes – in Bazi the sign of money and possessions. Good months to negotiate and secure income.
ausblick_bazi.monat_beherrscht_3: Again your Day Master ({dm}) dominates {monat}: money and opportunities are within reach. Take hold, but don't overreach.

ausblick_bazi.jahr_naehrt: With Lichun, the start of spring, the year of the {jahr} begins. Its element nourishes your Day Master ({dm}) – a year with a tailwind and backing.
ausblick_bazi.jahr_erschoepft: With Lichun, the start of spring, the year of the {jahr} begins. Your Day Master ({dm}) nourishes its element – a productive year that demands a lot of strength.
ausblick_bazi.jahr_kontrolliert: With Lichun, the start of spring, the year of the {jahr} begins. Its element puts pressure on your Day Master ({dm}) – a year of proving yourself and of duties.
ausblick_bazi.jahr_beherrscht: With Lichun, the start of spring, the year of the {jahr} begins. Your Day Master ({dm}) dominates its element – a year in which you can bring in the harvest.

westlich_ruhig.text: Today no transiting planet is in close aspect to your natal Sun or your natal Moon – a day without big impulses from outside, well suited to working at your own pace.

tendenz_positiv.liebe: In love, a lot is possible today – show someone what they mean to you.
tendenz_positiv.beruf: At work you have a tailwind today; plans can be moved forward well.
tendenz_positiv.finanzen: In money matters you have a good instinct today – a sensible decision comes more easily.
tendenz_positiv.gesundheit: Your energy is good today; use it for exercise or for something that does you good.
tendenz_positiv.soziales: Encounters are under a friendly star today – get in touch with someone.
tendenz_positiv.kreativitaet: Your creativity is stirred today – write ideas down, even if they are unfinished.
tendenz_positiv.veraenderung: Changes come more easily to you today than usual – a good day for a first step.
tendenz_positiv.spiritualitaet: Today your inner sense is clear – a quiet moment for yourself can clarify a lot.

tendenz_negativ.liebe: In love, sensitivity is called for today – not every word has to be said right away.
tendenz_negativ.beruf: At work things may be sluggish today; small finished steps are worth more than big plans.
tendenz_negativ.finanzen: In money matters, caution is wise today – larger expenses can wait.
tendenz_negativ.gesundheit: Your strength is limited today; allow yourself breaks instead of pushing past your limits.
tendenz_negativ.soziales: In your dealings with others, the gears may grind today – composure spares you needless arguments.
tendenz_negativ.kreativitaet: Ideas don't flow on their own today – routine work is the better plan.
tendenz_negativ.veraenderung: Today is not a day for upheavals; tending what already exists achieves more.
tendenz_negativ.spiritualitaet: Inner restlessness may be louder than usual today – a little structure gives you something to hold on to.

ausgeglichen.text: Today the forces in this horoscope are in balance – no area stands out in particular.
